SINDH
LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend certain laws in force in the
Province of Sindh
[Gazette
of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 4th July, 2017]
NO.PAS/Legis-B-15/2017, dated
4.7.2017.---The Sindh Laws (Amendment)
Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 18th May, 2017 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 19th June, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS
it is expedient to amend certain laws in force in the Province of Sindh;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and Commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Sindh Laws (Amendment)
Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and
from 1st day of July, 2016.

on 18th May, 2017 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 19th June, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS
it is expedient to amend certain laws in force in the Province of Sindh;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-

1.
The Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act,
1974 (Act No.XXVI of 1974).
1. In section 3, for the words twenty
four thousand , the words fifty thousand shall be substituted.
2. In section 3-A, for the words four
thousand eight hundred , the words ten thousand shall be substituted.
3. In section 3-B, for the words
sixteen thousand rupees , the words forty five thousand shall be
substituted.
4. In section 3-C, for the words four
thousand eight hundred , the words fifteen thousand shall be substituted.
5. In section 4, for the words eight
hundred eighty rupees and for the words six hundred forty rupees , the
words one thousand rupees shall be respectively substituted.
6. In section 4-B, for the words two
thousand four hundred rupees , the words five thousand shall be
substituted.
7. In section 5-A
(i) in
subsection (1), for the words one hundred and twenty thousand rupees , the
words two hundred thousand rupees shall be substituted;
(ii) in subsection (2), for the words one
hundred thousand rupees , the words one hundred and fifty thousand rupees
shall be substituted.
8. In section 6, in subsection (1), for
the words five thousand , the words ten thousand shall be substituted.
9. In section 6-B, for the words eight
thousand , the words fifteen thousand shall be substituted.
10. Compensation in case of Air or Road
Accident Rs. 50,00,000/= for Member of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh.
2.
The Sindh Speaker s and Deputy Speaker s (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (Act No. VII of 1975).
1. In section 3-A, for the words seven
thousand , the words fifty thousand shall be substituted.
2. In section 5, in subsection (1), for
the words eight thousand and seventy thousand , the words one hundred fifty
thousand and one hundred forty thousand shall respectively be substituted.
3. In section 6, in subsection (2), for
the words fifty five thousand three hundred and the words forty nine
thousand , the words seventy thousand and the words sixty thousand shall
respectively be substituted.
4. In section 7-A, for the words five
hundred thousand rupees and three hundred thousand rupees , the words ten
hundred thousand rupees and five hundred thousand rupees shall respectively
be substituted.
5. In section 8, for the words eight
thousand four hundred , the words twenty thousand shall be substituted.
6. In section 10, for the words seven
hundred and seventy , the words two thousand and one thousand and five
hundred shall be substituted.
7. Residence Maintenance Allowance
(Instead of Furnishing Government/ Private Residence) Rs.70,000/= for Speaker
and Rs. 50, 000/= for Deputy Speaker respectively per month.
8. Compensation in case of Air or Road
Accident Rs.50,00,000/= for Speaker and the Deputy Speaker respectively.
3.
The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
Act, 1975 (Act No. VIII of 1975).
1. In section 3-A, for the words
fifteen thousand rupees and five thousand rupees , the words twenty
thousand rupees shall be substituted.
2. For section 5, the following shall be
substituted:-
5. Salary. The salary of
the Chief Minister and a Minister shall respectively be one hundred fifty
thousand rupees and seventy five thousand rupees per mensem.
3. In section 6, for the words thirteen
thousand rupees and nine thousand rupees , the words twenty thousand rupees
